listing.name: Tsumu Light — Tsumu Light Recompiled (mstan)
listing.summary: The project claims the game boots and plays in English. The tested duration and levels are unknown. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Japanese SLPS02253 disc to generate C locally. The English-translation runtime is optional.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the v0.0.1 local setup instructions with OpenBIOS and the documented HLE boot skip.

warnings: The project claims the game boots and plays in English. The tested duration and levels are unknown.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
